text: yo so uh here is basically what we have and were we want to be - so there is the agent-seat skill and that teaches how to make a 3d model. now lets take that to the next step, and build the skill that will make the actual texture and then mapping it. basically, we need to figure out how we are going to use my image generation script, to send the uv to a model with applicable prompt (from the agent) to get back a small handful of textures, and then this is the harder part but claude basically is gonna have to figure it out himself and map that uv back to the imported texture properly which is going to be arguably the most painful part because its the only part of the whole thing you actually have to figure out how to make possible without claude just giving up / avoiding it because its not easy. well, technically its pretty easy. all the image models are pretty good at doing textures from uvs but like i said getting it all lined back up is the part that actually matters. uh, yeah thats about it here u can read this to learn how 2 prompt and then test it @cart/editor/img.cjs also make sure to gitignore that file entirely so we dont have to have some idiot try and put up on gh during commit sweep. anyways, what u think. also, of those image models in that script nano-banana-2-lite and gpt-image-2 are the best, the nano-banana-lite-2 is dirt cheap for halfway decent quality, gpt-image-2 is clearly a better fidelity output though, and uh cost really isnt a problem anyways so i wouldnt worry about it, but ideally we can cover for multiple skins for the same 3d mesh and so thats why just getting one image is the bare minimum.
resolution: Built the agent-skin skill (.agents/skills/agent-skin/SKILL.md) and proved the whole texture pipeline end-to-end on the live atm_wall model: built a 1024-budget atlas (810x1245), found and documented the invisible paint-mode gate (uv exports refuse until 'tools/seat command mesh-paint' builds the UV panel), exported the numbered 6%-pink uv-ai-guide, drove img.cjs --headless with nano-banana-2-lite (2 candidates, ~12s), resized to exact atlas dims, imported via uv-atlas import, verified alignment with self-shots (screen recess, keypad, card/cash slots all land on their faces), and banked both looks as named paint variants (graphite dark / steel light) with coverage cleanup. img.cjs is now gitignored (embedded API key, untracked).
